messages.subject: Re: [nat-user] Re: flycircuit boundingbox
parts:
Dear Wenbin,

If you search virtual fly brain for MBON you will get this page:

http://www.virtualflybrain.org/site/stacks/index.htm?id=FBbt_00047953

If you click on images … List All (35) you will get this page.

http://www.virtualflybrain.org/do/individual_list.html?action=exemplar_neuron&id=FBbt:00047953

These images come from a variety of sources (including flycircuit).

For the flycircuit neurons you can read the skeletons using their identifier.

http://natverse.org/flycircuit/reference/fc_read_neurons.html

If you need to do a lot of work of this sort, there is an R package that can do programmatic queries of the VFB website.

https://github.com/jefferis/vfbr
https://jefferis.github.io/vfbr/reference/index.html

Best,

Greg.
